## Scope and behavior

Describe the concrete change, exact target/package/board revision, peripheral instance/mode and exclusions.
If adding a catalog goal, explain its workflow bindings and any denominator change.

## Evidence and provenance

List source versions/hashes, reviewed source locators, normalized records and new immutable bundle revision.
Identify editorial review separately from independent engineering review. Preserve source notices.

## Validation

List commands actually run and outcomes; disclose skipped checks and tools/versions.
Include relevant negative fixtures and deterministic publication / real MCP checks when applicable.
Separate source review, modeled ordering, target compilation, ELF validation and physical behavior.

## Hardware results, if tested

State exact artifact, board revision (or unknown), wiring/stimuli, observations, failed windows and limitations.
Redact probe serials, private paths, grants and raw logs. No physical test is required for a source-only contribution.

## Remaining work

State unsupported modes, unresolved conflicts, blocked dependencies and qualification gaps.
See CONTRIBUTING.md; do not mark missing evidence as complete to obtain passing checks.
